copy: Alisios Residences is a collection of 34 apartments and penthouses set in the Alta de Guadalmina area of Marbella, one of the Costa del Sol's most established addresses, close to San Pedro Alcántara and Puerto Banús.
Wide glazing and generous terraces are designed around the Guadalmina golf course and sea views, paired with a gated resort-style amenity offer that includes a pool, gym and co-working space.

why.copy: This project suits buyers who want golf-course and sea views, a gated resort-style setting and easy access to San Pedro and Puerto Banús.
points: Buyers who want golf and sea views with resort-style amenities close to Puerto Banús.
A gated, low-density Golf Valley setting with pool, gym and co-working space rather than a busy beachfront block.
Guadalmina sits between San Pedro Alcántara and Puerto Banús, with several golf courses within 10 minutes.
Only 34 homes make up the whole development, so confirmed pricing and floor changes quickly.

copy: The building uses a reinforced-concrete structural frame with insulated perforated-brick facades, chosen for thermal and acoustic efficiency as much as appearance.
Homes are climate-controlled by an aerothermal system handling heating, cooling and hot water, paired with underfloor heating and high-end interior finishes throughout.
highlights: Reinforced-concrete foundations and structural frame for durability and stability.
Insulated perforated-brick facades for thermal and acoustic performance.
Aerothermal climate system integrating heating, cooling and hot water.
Underfloor heating throughout, with high-end interior finishes as standard.
Fully equipped kitchens with premium appliances and customisable finishes.
